method.name: from_definition
method.description: Adapt a saved or legacy definition using a detached snapshot.

method.name: lan
method.description: Select direct play with total capacity including the listen host. Defaults to two.

method.name: steam
method.description: Select Steam listen play. Null settings use the launch app and invite-only visibility. Capacity defaults to two.

method.name: steam_server
method.description: Select a configured Steam dedicated server. Capacity defaults to two remote players.

method.name: on_port
method.description: Set the configured UDP port, from 1 to 65535, on a branch.

method.name: world_id
method.description: Set a durable starting world ID. The fixed-world default is start.

method.name: with_world
method.description: Add a destination to a coordinated draft.

method.name: provider
method.description: Select an optional typed provider to run at boot.

method.name: inventory
method.description: Enable game-owned inventory on a coordinated profile.

method.name: player_controls
method.description: Returns a branch that enables authority-driven movement and look for fixed-world play. Omit [param profile] to read movement settings from one [MoverComponent] directly under the player scene's [CharacterBody3D] root. Boot reports invalid or missing scene setup through [method Game.boot_result]. Supply an explicit profile to use its movement settings instead. Enable prediction on compatible grounded capsules for client prediction and server reconciliation against immutable static collision. Use compatible player scenes and the same movement protocol on each peer. The authority captures movement rules and speed at boot. Attach local input through a [ControlsComponent] or [PlayerControlProfile] when the world is ready.

method.name: boot
method.description: Attach private services to a live scene-tree owner. Check the returned Game's boot_result for a configuration failure.

method.name: boot_server
method.description: Attach the game and native CLI launcher. The launcher runs for the explicit server role.
